title: Marie Nussbaum — Clinical psychologist & psychoanalyst, Paris 7th
desc: A quiet space for deep listening at 26 boulevard Raspail, Paris 7th. Sessions for adults, adolescents and children, in English and French, in person or online.
h1: A quiet space for deep listening, in the 7th arrondissement.
lead: At 26 boulevard Raspail, in a light-filled office overlooking the rooftops, I see adults, adolescents and children — in English and in French, in person or online.
photoAlt: Marie Nussbaum, in her consulting room

qui.texte: Mental overload, silent collapses, burnout — a confidential space for those who carry a great deal and have nowhere to set it down.
Cross-cultural couples, children between two languages, lives between two cities. A transcultural practice, in English as in French.
High expectations, vivid sensitivity, crossroads moments — at the age when everything feels decisive. Adjusted fees.

qui.titre: Children & teens who don’t fit the mold
qui.texte: High potential or genuine cognitive difficulties: through play and creativity, tailored support. The child is always the first patient.

avantHtml: Before the consulting room, I spent fifteen years in global companies, working alongside senior executives — including several years in London, Sweden and Australia: high responsibility and expat life are worlds I know from the inside.
appr: A setting that is rigorous and flexible at once, adjusting to your real life — including when that life moves between cities or languages.

The point is not to apply techniques to “feel better fast”, but to understand in depth what repeats, stays silent or overflows — and gradually to open other ways of being in relation to yourself and to others.
My practice rests on continuous institutional experience — including two years at the psychoanalytic centre of the GHU Sainte-Anne in Paris — and regular supervision (UFORCA, EPFCL).
exergue: “There is no psychic prêt-à-porter: every story calls for made-to-measure.”
visioH2: Keeping the work going, from wherever you are.
visioP: Part of my practice lives abroad or between cities. Online sessions let us begin or continue the work at a distance, within the office’s opening hours — mornings often suit Asia, late afternoons the Americas.
visioPts: Office-hour slots, planned around your time zone
Remote parental guidance for international families
visioAlt: Watercolour — a consultation open onto the world
cabP: A bright top-floor space, reached through a discreet courtyard just off Sèvres-Babylone — the discretion of the 7ᵉ, in a room designed for conversation.
cabAlt: The consulting room — armchairs face to face, an antique writing desk, Paris rooftops through the window
languesNote: Working notions of Spanish, German, Swedish, Russian
carnetsH2: Thinking through what life does to us.
